wiki.title: Diane Blair-Sherlock
wiki.extract: Diane Blair-Sherlock is an American politician serving as a member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 46th district. She went to the College of Dupage and Northern Illinois University where she got a B.A in Political Science. She then attended John Marshall Law School where she got her Juris Doctor. She is a wife and a mother of two and currently resides in Villa Park.
